old_caption: The video captures a vibrant nighttime fireworks display over a body of water, likely a lake or river, with a large crowd gathered on the shore to watch. The fireworks burst in green and pink hues, transitioning to mostly white, creating a dazzling spectacle against the dark sky. Smoke trails from the explosions rise into the air, adding to the visual drama. In the background, silhouettes of buildings and structures are faintly visible, suggesting an urban setting. A large blue whale-shaped structure is prominently lit up on the right side of the frame, adding a whimsical element to the scene. The camera remains static throughout the sequence, showing the fireworks and the crowd without panning.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a vibrant nighttime fireworks display over a body of water, likely a lake or river, with a large crowd gathered on the shore to watch. The fireworks burst in various colors—shades of white, yellow, and red—creating a dazzling spectacle against the dark sky. Smoke trails from the explosions rise into the air, adding to the visual drama. In the background, silhouettes of buildings and structures are faintly visible, suggesting an urban setting. A large blue whale-shaped structure is prominently lit up on the right side of the frame, adding a whimsical element to the scene. The crowd, composed of people of various ages, is seen enjoying the show, some holding up their phones to capture the moment. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the fireworks and the crowd, providing a clear view of the event's atmosphere and scale.
caption: The video captures a nighttime fireworks display over a calm body of water, viewed from behind a dense standing crowd. In the upper left, an aerial shell burst is open from the first frame and continues to spread radially, its streaks shifting from greenish-white through pink and red before blooming into bright silver chrysanthemum sparks that thin into scattered fading embers. Along the far shoreline, three vertical columns of ground-level fountain jets fire upward throughout the excerpt, their rising streaks mirrored as reflections on the water, with the right column fanning sparks outward in the later frames. A pale smoke plume hangs in the upper-middle sky and drifts slowly rightward, accumulating as the bursts dissipate. On the right bank, a large illuminated whale-shaped installation sits in place, its lower body tinting from blue toward purple and pink. Lit buildings remain faintly visible behind the installation. The camera framing of the crowd, waterline, and whale stays fixed across the clip.

Write a corrected WISA-style training caption for this exact video clip.
This clip is a temporally cropped excerpt, with arbitrary start and end boundaries. It is NOT
necessarily a complete action and it is NOT a loop. Describe the visible portion of a process
without inventing how it began or how it ultimately ends. A process may already be happening
on the first frame and still be happening after the last. Do not force the endpoints to match,
infer a physical error from their mismatch, or manufacture continuity across a visible edit.
Use the chronological video as primary evidence. The independent visual notes are fallible aids,
not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.
Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.
Aim for 85-115% of the original WISA word count,
and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
